notes: Dragon Valor (USA) disc 1 (SLUS-01092; disc 2 SLUS-01164 carries the same EXE). The boot EXE clears its BSS from 0x800774A8 up to 0x800BBEF0 at entry and uses 0x800BBEF0 as the heap base; the five mode modules under BIN/ are read whole (header included) into that address, one at a time.
Same loader as the PAL release (there: 0x800BC268); MAP.BIN / OPENNING.BIN header pointers sit 0x378 lower, matching the base shift.

images.note: 1.7 KB module the generic detector does not vote on; same loader slot, static root discovery only.
